claims.text: The hotel is situated in Beijing's central business district.

findings.quote: Situated in the central business district, Park Hyatt Beijing ensures you’re central to so much of what this city offers.

claims.text: The hotel sits within the Beijing Yintai Centre skyscraper on Chang'an Avenue.

findings.quote: It sits within the tallest skyscraper (Beijing Yintai Centre) on bustling Chang’an Avenue thoroughfare

claims.text: The lobby is on the 63rd floor.

findings.quote: directing you to the lobby on the 63rd floor
The reception is in the 63rd floor

claims.text: Guomao subway station is a one-minute walk from the front door.

findings.quote: the nearby Guomao subway station (a one-minute walk from the front door)

claims.text: China World Mall is connected to the hotel via underground passageways.

findings.quote: China World Mall is directly connected to the via underground passageways

claims.text: Each room has 300-thread-count linens, down duvets, a separate shower, a walk-in closet and a coffee machine.

findings.quote: Each room comes with 300-thread-count linens and down duvets, separate shower, walk-in closet and a coffee machine.

claims.text: Rooms have a centralized PM2.5 air purification system.

findings.quote: Centralized PM2.5 air purification system

claims.text: China Grill specialises in premium meat, fish and seafood.

findings.quote: Specialising in premium meat, fish and seafood

claims.text: At lunch and dinner, Dining Room serves Cantonese and Chaozhou-style dishes.

findings.quote: At lunch and dinner, the restaurant serves a refined selection of refreshing Cantonese and Chaozhou-style dishes.

claims.text: China Bar serves vintage wines and Champagnes by the glass, cocktails, whiskeys and Cognacs, with daily live entertainment.

findings.quote: serving vintage wines and Champagnes by the glass, cocktails, whiskeys and Cognacs, along with daily ‘live’ entertainment.

claims.text: Tian Spa draws on ancient Chinese wellness practices.

findings.quote: The spa draws on a rich history of ancient Chinese wellness practices to discover fluidity in mind and spirit.

claims.text: Breakfast includes Beijing specialties, each with a small sign explaining the dish's history.

findings.quote: I was most impressed with the Beijing specialties on offer, with small signs next to each one explaining the history of the dish.

claims.text: At China Grill, diners sit beneath a Chinese lantern-style glass pyramid ceiling at the building's apex, with glass walls, trees and water features.

findings.quote: Visitors dine beneath a dramatic Chinese “lantern” at the building’s apex, featuring a soaring glass pyramid ceiling and glass walls, and surrounded by trees and water features.

claims.text: Park Hyatt Beijing was the first Park Hyatt to open in China.

findings.quote: was the first Park Hyatt to open in China

claims.text: In the rooms, one push on the doors reveals skyline views from the soaking tub or the shower.

findings.quote: Just one gentle push on the doors reveals skyline views from the soaking tub or the shower.

claims.text: Dining Room is a Chinese restaurant on the 63rd floor with panoramic city views.

findings.quote: Dining Room – The Sky-High Chinese Restaurant at Park Hyatt Beijing, located on the 63rd floor with panoramic views of the city.

claims.text: Dining Room invites guest chefs from Hyatt hotels in other Chinese cities to bring regional flavors.

findings.quote: invites guest chefs from Hyatt hotels in different cities across China to bring authentic regional flavors to Beijing diners

claims.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in mainland China.

findings.quote: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

claims.text: Many sites are blocked in China, including Google and Gmail.

findings.quote: many sites are blocked in China, including Google and Gmail, among others

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the business district location may lack a traditional cultural atmosphere.
